cases.situation: I do digital pet and people portraits: $85 for one person or pet, $30 for each extra, about 10 days, one round of edits included. Someone named Maya DMed 'hi how much for a portrait?' and nothing else.
cases.reply: Hi Maya! A digital portrait of one person or pet is $85, and each extra one is $30. Turnaround is about 10 days, with one round of edits included. Who's it for?
cases.note: Price in the first line, the extra she'll want next, and one question that moves toward a booking.

cases.situation: 我在小红书卖手作耳环，这款珍珠耳环只剩两对，耳针是925银的，可以帮人留到第二天晚上8点。有人私信："在吗？这个珍珠耳环还有吗"
cases.reply: 在的！这款珍珠耳环还剩最后两对，耳针是925银的。需要的话我帮你留到明晚8点，直接拍就行～
cases.note: 对方话少，回复也短：先回答有没有，再给一个她会关心的细节和一个下一步。

cases.situation: Someone DMed asking the price of my handmade ceramic mugs. I said $38 and they replied 'lol $38 for a mug? the supermarket has them for $5'.
cases.reply: Totally fair, they're not for everyone. $38 is the price for these, and no hard feelings either way. Thanks for asking!
cases.note: Don't defend the number. If they keep arguing or get insulting, stop replying.

cases.situation: I run a mobile dog grooming van: a full groom for a golden is $110, heavy matting adds up to $20, and this Saturday, 3 October, I have 9am and 1pm free. Someone just DMed 'hey r u free this sat? golden retriever, pretty matted'
cases.reply: Hey! Yes, I've got 9am or 1pm this Saturday, the 3rd. A full groom for a golden is $110, and heavy matting can add up to $20, which I'll confirm when I see the coat. Want the 9am or the 1pm?
cases.note: Two exact slots, the matting cost flagged up front so there's no surprise, and one easy question.

cases.situation: Hago tortas por encargo en Montevideo: una torta temática para 40 personas sale $3.800 con decoración y cartel con el nombre, y pido una seña de $1.500. Me escribió Valentina por Instagram: '¿hacés tortas para 40 personas? Es para el sábado 10 de octubre, tema Frozen', y ese día lo tengo libre.
cases.reply: ¡Hola Valentina! Sí, tengo lugar para el sábado 10. Una torta temática de Frozen para 40 personas sale $3.800 e incluye la decoración y el cartel con el nombre. Para reservar la fecha pido una seña de $1.500; ¿te paso los datos para transferir?
cases.note: Encargo con fecha: primero confirmá que hay lugar y el precio, después la seña como único paso siguiente.

cases.situation: 我在小红书卖手工皮具，一个长钱包380元，不打折；买两个送两个同色钥匙扣，包邮，一般3天到，颜色都有现货。有人私信：'能便宜点吗？买两个呢'
cases.reply: 单个就是380，价格不打折哈。买两个的话送两个同色钥匙扣，包邮，一般3天到。你想要什么颜色？我拍现货给你看。
cases.note: 先答价格不绕弯，不降价但给一个买两个的实在好处，最后一个问题推进下单。

cases.situation: I'm a florist. On Sunday a bride, Hannah, asked on WhatsApp about flowers for her wedding on October 17. I quoted $1,450 for her bouquet, 4 bridesmaid posies and 20 table centrepieces. Blue ticks, no reply. That's my last free Saturday in October.
cases.reply: Hi Hannah, just checking whether you'd like me to hold Saturday 17 October for your flowers. It's my last free Saturday that month, so I can keep it for you until Friday. Totally fine if you've gone another way.
cases.note: One follow-up about 48 hours after the price, with a true reason to reply and an easy no. If nothing comes back, leave it.

cases.situation: 我在成都开陶艺工作室，体验课每周六下午2点到5点，298元一位，含材料和烧制，老师手把手教拉坯做杯子或碗，最多6人，成品三周后到店取或包邮寄回；这周六10月3号还剩2个位置。有人在小红书私信：'你们的体验课是怎么上的？零基础可以吗'
cases.reply: 可以的，体验课就是给零基础准备的！每周六下午2点到5点，298元一位，含材料和烧制，老师手把手带你拉坯，做好的杯子或碗三周后来店里取，或者包邮寄给你。每场最多6个人。这周六10月3号还剩2个位置，要帮你留一个吗？
cases.note: 先答'可以'，再补上时间、价格和她会想知道的取件方式，最后只问一个问题推进报名。

cases.situation: I make hand-poured soy candles in 9 scents and sell them on Instagram for $32 each; wholesale is $16 a candle, 24-candle minimum mixed across scents, shipped within a week, fig is my bestseller, and I have a wholesale sheet listing all the scents. A gift shop owner in Portland, Jenna, just DMed 'hi! do you do wholesale? love the fig one'.
cases.reply: Hi Jenna! Yes, wholesale is $16 a candle, with a 24-candle minimum that you can mix across scents. Orders ship within a week, and the fig one is our bestseller, so it's a good pick. Want me to send over the wholesale sheet with all 9 scents?
cases.note: Wholesale inquiry: answer with the price and minimum first, add the one fact a shop owner needs next, then one easy next step.

cases.situation: I sell linen aprons on Instagram. Someone DMed 'hi! is the rust apron back in stock? it's for my mom's bday on oct 10'. The rust restock doesn't arrive until Oct 16; the terracotta, a shade lighter, is in stock, and orders by Monday Oct 5 arrive by the 10th.
cases.reply: Hi! The rust one is back on Oct 16, so it won't make the 10th, sorry. The terracotta is in stock, a shade lighter, and orders by Monday Oct 5 arrive in time. Want a photo of the two side by side?
cases.note: Answer first even when it's a no, then the nearest option that meets their real deadline, and one easy question.

cases.situation: I sell custom embroidered baby blankets on Instagram: $65 with a name, about 8 days to make plus 3 for shipping. Tara DMed 'is the cotton organic? want one for my nephew Theo'. My mill says it is, but I want to check their certificate first, which I can do by 8pm tonight.
cases.reply: Hi Tara! A blanket with Theo's name is $65, and it takes about 8 days to make plus 3 for shipping. On the organic question, I want to check the certificate with my mill before I say yes, so I'll come back to you by 8pm tonight. Any colour in mind while I check?
cases.note: When you can't confirm a claim yet, answer what you can, give a time for the rest, and don't promise until you've checked.

cases.situation: Vendo luminárias de cerâmica feitas à mão pelo Instagram, aqui em Belo Horizonte, a R$ 290 cada; o frete para Portugal é R$ 180 por luminária, com rastreio, e leva 15 a 25 dias úteis; o imposto de importação, se houver, é cobrado na entrega pelas regras de Portugal, e posso mandar um link com o total já calculado. A Inês, de Lisboa, mandou DM: "Olá! Enviam para Portugal?"
cases.reply: Olá, Inês! Enviamos, sim. O frete para Portugal sai R$ 180 por luminária, com rastreio, e chega em 15 a 25 dias úteis. Pode haver imposto de importação cobrado na entrega, conforme as regras de Portugal, então vale confirmar antes de comprar. Quer que eu te mande o link com o valor total já calculado?
cases.note: Pedido internacional: sim ou não na primeira linha, depois frete e prazo, e o aviso sobre taxas para não haver surpresa.

cases.situation: 我在朋友圈和小红书卖自己设计的连衣裙，一条459元；我的规则是收到7天内没穿过、吊牌在就能退或换码，换码来回运费我出。有人私信：“不合适能退吗？我在S和M之间，怕买错。”
cases.reply: 可以的，收到7天内没穿过、吊牌还在，退或换码都行，换码的来回运费我出。你方便说下身高体重和平时穿的码吗？我帮你挑一个更稳的。
cases.note: 先答能不能退，再把换码运费这个顾虑提前解决，最后只问一个问题帮她选码。

cases.situation: 我在小红书卖手工冷制皂，燕麦款58元一块，成分是橄榄油、椰子油、燕麦粉和乳木果油，无香精无色素，另有20克小样12元。有个宝妈私信：“宝宝8个月，有湿疹，这个能给他用吗？”
cases.reply: 这个我没法替医生打包票，湿疹宝宝能不能用，最好先问问给他看湿疹的医生。燕麦款的成分是橄榄油、椰子油、燕麦粉和乳木果油，无香精无色素，完整成分表可以直接拿给医生看。医生说可以的话，我这边有20克的小样，12元，先少量试一下更放心。要我把成分表发给你吗？
cases.note: 涉及宝宝皮肤健康，不做功效承诺：先给诚实的答案，再给成分和小样，让她和医生决定。

cases.situation: I'm a personal trainer: $70 an hour or $600 for ten, the first session starts with a movement check, and this week I have Friday 7am or Saturday 9am free. A guy named Ollie DMed me on Instagram last Friday: 'hey how much for 1 on 1 sessions? total beginner'. I only just saw it today, five days later.
cases.reply: Hi Ollie, sorry for the slow reply, I've only just seen this. One-to-one sessions are $70 an hour, or $600 for a pack of ten, and the first one starts with a relaxed movement check, so total beginner is exactly right. I've got Friday at 7am or Saturday at 9am this week, would either suit you?
cases.note: Replying days late: one line of ownership, then the answer straight away, so the apology doesn't become the message.

cases.situation: 我在小红书卖手工香薰蜡烛，128元一只，免费礼盒包装，可以写手写卡片。有人私信：“想送男朋友，雪松和白茶哪个好？他不喜欢甜的味道。”雪松是木质调偏沉稳，白茶清淡干净，两款都不甜。
cases.reply: 两款都不甜，放心！雪松是木质调，偏沉稳；白茶更清淡、干净。都是128元一只，免费礼盒包装，还能帮你写手写卡片。他平时喜欢沉稳一点的味道，还是清爽一点的？我帮你一起定。
cases.note: 帮顾客在两款之间选：先回答她最在意的（不甜），再讲清区别，用一个问题帮她决定，不替她拍板。

cases.situation: I'm a hairdresser working from a home salon. Chloe DMed 'how much for balayage? shoulder length, currently box dyed dark brown'. My balayage is $180 for shoulder length, box dye usually needs a colour-removal step first for $60, and I do free 15-minute consults to check the hair.
cases.reply: Hi Chloe! Balayage on shoulder-length hair is $180. With box dye you'll most likely need a colour-removal step first, which is $60, so plan on about $240 in total. I can confirm the exact price at a free 15-minute consult; want me to find you a time this week?
cases.note: When the price depends on the hair, still give the number: the base, the likely extra, the likely total, then the step that pins it down.

cases.situation: I sell restored vintage road bikes on Instagram, sold in person in Portland for cash or bank transfer on collection. Someone DMed about a 1984 steel road bike listed at $420: 'I'll pay $500 if you hold it, I'll mail a cheque and my mover will collect'. I hold bikes only with a $50 deposit by bank transfer.
cases.reply: Hi! It's still available at $420. I only sell in person here in Portland, paid by cash or bank transfer at collection, so I can't take a cheque or anything over the price. I can hold it for you with a $50 deposit by bank transfer. When would you like to come and see it?
cases.note: Overpayment plus a posted cheque plus a third-party collector is a common scam pattern: stick to your terms and never send money back.

cases.situation: Instagramで革小物を販売しています。今日は9月30日（水）です。キーケース（4,800円）について佐藤さんからDM：「名入れってできますか？10月9日の金曜日までに欲しいです」。名入れは＋800円でローマ字8文字まで、注文から発送まで5営業日、佐藤さんは東京在住とのことで発送の翌日に届きます。
cases.reply: 佐藤さん、はい、名入れできます！キーケースへの刻印は＋800円で、ローマ字8文字までです。発送まで5営業日かかるので、明日10月1日（木）中にご注文いただければ9日（金）にお届けできます。入れたい文字を教えていただければ、ご注文リンクをお送りしますね。
cases.note: 締め切りから逆算した注文日を先に伝えると、急かさずに次の一歩が明確になる。

cases.situation: I make custom cookie gift boxes. Priya ordered 30 boxes for her team from me last December, and today she DMed on Instagram: 'hi again!! can we do the same as last year but 45 boxes, delivered Dec 11?' Dec 11 is free, my price is now $24 a box (it was $22), and I need orders confirmed by Nov 20.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, lovely to hear from you again! Yes, December 11 works, and 45 boxes are $24 each this year, so $1,080 in total. Once you confirm by November 20, the date is yours. Shall I pencil you in now?
cases.note: A returning customer gets the new price stated plainly in the first answer, not discovered at checkout.

cases.situation: I run a pottery studio in a converted shop. Grace DMed: 'is your studio wheelchair accessible? want to book my mum's birthday class on oct 17'. There's one small step at the door and we have a portable ramp, one wheel table fits a wheelchair, but the toilet is up a flight of stairs; the 2pm class that Saturday still has space.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, mostly yes: there's one small step at the door and we have a portable ramp for it, and one of our wheel tables fits a wheelchair. The one thing that isn't accessible is the toilet, which is up a flight of stairs. The 2pm class on Saturday 17 October has space; shall I hold a spot at the accessible table for your mum?
cases.note: Name the one thing that isn't accessible up front, so they decide now rather than discover it on the day.

cases.situation: 我在杭州做上门喂猫，一般一天上门一次，每次60元，含喂粮、换水、铲屎和发视频，两只猫不加价。有人微信问：“国庆5号到8号出门，能上门喂两只猫吗？”这几天我都还有空。
cases.reply: 可以的，5号到8号我都有空！每次60元，两只猫不加价，包括喂粮、换水、铲屎，每次上门都会给您发视频。一天上门一次的话，4天一共240元。您家在哪个小区？我确认一下路线，就帮您把这几天留出来。
cases.note: 替对方把总价算好：问假期上门，其实是想知道这几天一共要花多少。

cases.situation: J'ai une chambre d'hôtes en Dordogne : 85 € la nuit pour deux, petit-déjeuner compris, et les chiens sont acceptés pour 10 € la nuit ; le jardin est clos. Camille m'écrit sur Instagram : « Bonjour ! Vous avez de la place les nuits du vendredi 16 et du samedi 17 octobre pour 2 adultes et un chien ? Le petit-déj est compris ? » La chambre du jardin est libre ces deux nuits.
cases.reply: Bonjour Camille ! Oui, la chambre du jardin est libre les nuits du vendredi 16 et du samedi 17 octobre, et le petit-déjeuner est compris. C'est 85 € la nuit pour deux, plus 10 € la nuit pour votre chien, soit 190 € pour le week-end. Le jardin est clos, il pourra s'y dégourdir les pattes. Je vous bloque la chambre ?
cases.note: Plusieurs questions dans un message : répondre à chacune dans l'ordre, faire le total à sa place, puis une seule question pour réserver.

cases.situation: 我在杭州做私人写真摄影，单人写真套餐1880元，含2小时拍摄和30张精修。有人在小红书私信：“这个套餐可以分期吗？一次拿不出这么多。”我的做法是先付500元定金锁档期，拍摄当天付清剩下的1380元，不做更多分期。
cases.reply: 可以分两次付：先付500元定金锁定档期，剩下的1380元拍摄当天付清就行，再细分的分期我这边暂时不做。套餐含2小时拍摄和30张精修。你大概想约哪个月拍？我帮你看看档期。
cases.note: 被问能不能分期，先给一个能做到的付款方式，说清界限，不评价对方的预算。

cases.situation: 我在二手平台卖一台用了两年的微单相机，标价3200元，含两块原装电池和充电器。有买家私信：“有磕碰吗？快门多少？”机身底部有一处3毫米左右的掉漆，屏幕没有划痕，快门大约1.2万次；我可以拍细节图，同城能当面验货，外地包邮。
cases.reply: 快门大约1.2万次。机身底部有一处3毫米左右的掉漆，屏幕没有划痕，我这就拍细节图发你。3200元含两块原装电池和充电器，同城可以当面验货，外地包邮。你在哪个城市？
cases.note: 二手卖家先把瑕疵说清楚，比买家收货后自己发现强得多。

cases.situation: I tutor GCSE maths online for £40 an hour and do a free 20-minute first call. A mum, Karen, WhatsApped: 'How much? My son Josh is predicted a 3 and needs a 4 in his exams next June. Can you guarantee he'll pass?' I have Tuesdays and Thursdays at 5pm free.
cases.reply: Hi Karen! It's £40 an hour. I can't honestly guarantee a grade, nobody can, but there's time between now and June to work on it properly. A free 20-minute first call lets me see where Josh is losing marks. I've got Tuesday or Thursday at 5pm; would either suit him?
cases.note: Price first, then an honest no to the guarantee: promising an outcome you don't control wins the booking and loses the trust.

cases.situation: 我在上海做家庭烘焙，纸杯蛋糕一盒12个168元。顾客阿依古丽私信问：“你们的蛋糕是清真的吗？”我的配方不含明胶、酒精和猪油，用的是动物黄油，香草是无酒精的香草精，但我家厨房没有清真认证。
cases.reply: 你好！先跟你说实话：我家厨房没有清真认证，所以我不能说是清真的。配方里不含明胶、酒精和猪油，用的是动物黄油，香草也是无酒精的香草精。一盒12个168元。要不要我把完整配料表发给你，你看看能不能接受？
cases.note: 涉及饮食和信仰，不替对方下结论：先说清没有认证，再给配料，让她自己决定。

cases.situation: I'm selling my oak dining table with four chairs on Facebook Marketplace for $350, collection only from my place in Oakland, and it needs two people to lift. Three people messaged 'is this available?' within an hour; Dana was first. My rule is that it goes to whoever puts down a $50 deposit or comes to see it first.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, yes, still available! It's $350 for the table and all four chairs, collection only from Oakland, and you'll want two people to lift it. A few people have asked, so it goes to whoever puts down a $50 deposit or comes to see it first. Would today or tomorrow work for a look?
cases.note: With several buyers at once, state your rule plainly to each one; it's the truth, not pressure.

cases.situation: 我在南京开花店。有位顾客微信私信：“我爸周二走了，10月9日周五上午在殡仪馆告别，他生前最喜欢向日葵，能做一个向日葵为主的花篮吗？”我们的告别花篮480元起，向日葵现在有货，市区殡仪馆免费送到，下单需要逝者姓名和挽联落款。
cases.reply: 您好，请节哀。可以做的，向日葵现在有货，用叔叔最喜欢的花送他，很好。告别花篮480元起，市区殡仪馆免费送到，会在10月9日周五上午告别前送到。方便的话，发我一下叔叔的姓名和挽联上落款的名字，我先帮您把花留好。
cases.note: 先一句节哀，再直接回答能不能做、多少钱、能不能送到；不推更贵的款式。

cases.situation: I run a small tattoo studio. Our policy is 18 and over with photo ID, no exceptions, even with a parent's consent. A girl named Mia DMed: 'hi im 16, can i get a small moon on my wrist if my mum comes with me? how much?' A small wrist piece like that is $90, and we can save a design request until someone turns 18.
cases.reply: Hi Mia! Thanks for asking first. We only tattoo people who are 18 or over with photo ID, even with a parent there, so I can't book you in yet. A small wrist moon like that is $90, and I can save your design idea for when you turn 18. Want me to?
cases.note: Answer the real question first, even when it's a no, and never sell around your own age policy.

cases.situation: I sell refurbished film cameras on Instagram from my studio in Austin. The Halden SL-2 is $260 with a 90-day warranty, and payment only goes through the card checkout on my shop, never gift cards or crypto; local buyers can also pick up and pay at the studio on Saturdays, 10 to 2, and I'm happy to hold a camera until Saturday for them. Leo DMed: 'is this legit? got scammed on insta last month, lost $150'.
cases.reply: Hi Leo, totally fair question after that, and sorry it happened to you. Yes, the SL-2 is $260 with a 90-day warranty, and payment only ever goes through the card checkout on my shop, never gift cards or crypto. If you're near Austin, you're welcome to come by the studio on a Saturday between 10 and 2, see it in person and pay then. Want me to put it aside for you this Saturday?
cases.note: When trust is the question, answer with checkable facts and an in-person option, not reassurance.

cases.situation: 我在小红书开手冲咖啡器具小店。专业套装（电子秤、温控手冲壶、磨豆机、滤杯）899元；入门组合（滤杯、细口壶、100张滤纸）159元，可以先用买来的现磨咖啡粉。有人私信：“新手想试试手冲，一周就喝两三次，899那个套装值得买吗？”
cases.reply: 说实话，一周喝两三次的话，先不用买899的套装。入门组合159元，有滤杯、细口壶和100张滤纸，先用买来的现磨粉就能冲，喜欢了再升级磨豆机也不迟。要我把入门组合的链接发你吗？
cases.note: 顾客问贵的值不值，诚实推荐更合适的入门款，长期信任比一单利润更值钱。

cases.situation: I make hand-poured wedding favour candles: the 2oz tin is $3.80 each, the 4oz is $6.50, custom labels with names and date are free on orders of 40 or more, and wedding orders need 3 weeks. A bride, Priya, DMed 'hi! I have about $200 for favours for 50 guests, what can you do?'
cases.reply: Hi Priya! For 50 guests, the 2oz tins come to $190, and custom labels with your names and date are free on orders of 40 or more. The 4oz tins would be $325, so the 2oz is the one that fits your budget. Wedding orders take 3 weeks; when's the big day?
cases.note: A budget-first question: lead with the option that fits their number, do the maths for them, then one question that moves to a booking.

cases.situation: I hand-knit cardigans and sell them on Instagram; ready-made sizes run XS to XL, and I knit any design to measurements for $40 extra, which takes about three weeks. Rosa DMed: 'love the Fern cardigan! do you go above XL? I'm usually a 3XL'. The Fern is $145, and I have a measuring guide I can send.
cases.reply: Hi Rosa! The ready-made Fern stops at XL, but I can knit it to your measurements for $40 extra, so $185 in total, and it takes about three weeks. Want me to send you the measuring guide?
cases.note: Answer the size question honestly in the first line, then the route that works, priced in full; nothing about her size beyond the measurements.

cases.situation: Ich habe eine kleine Fahrradwerkstatt in Köln. Lena schreibt mir auf Instagram: 'Hi, flickt ihr heute noch einen Platten? Hinterrad, brauche das Rad morgen früh für die Arbeit.' Ein neuer Schlauch hinten kostet bei uns 18 Euro inklusive Schlauch, bei Nabenschaltung 25 Euro; wer vor 16 Uhr kommt, kann in etwa 30 Minuten wieder fahren, und wir haben bis 18 Uhr offen.
cases.reply: Hallo Lena, ja, das machen wir heute noch! Wir wechseln dafür den Schlauch: hinten 18 Euro inklusive Schlauch, mit Nabenschaltung 25 Euro. Wenn du vor 16 Uhr kommst, ist das Rad in etwa 30 Minuten fertig und du kannst einfach warten; offen haben wir bis 18 Uhr. Schaffst du es vor 16 Uhr?
cases.note: Eilige Anfrage: das Ja in die erste Zeile, der Preis mit der einen Variante, die ihn ändert, und eine Frage, die direkt zum Termin führt.

cases.situation: 我在微信上卖手工牛轧糖礼盒，一盒98元，50盒以上团购价每盒88元，可以免费印公司logo贴纸，要提前15天下单，春节前发货的最晚1月20日前下单。我是个体户，能开增值税普通发票，开不了专用发票。一家公司的行政私信：“我们过年想订80盒发给员工，能开发票吗？大概多少钱？”
cases.reply: 可以开发票，不过我是个体户，只能开增值税普通发票，开不了专用发票，麻烦您先跟财务确认一下普票能不能报。80盒按团购价每盒88元，一共7040元，还可以免费印贵公司的logo贴纸。春节前要发的话，最晚1月20日前下单。要我先把开票信息表发给您吗？
cases.note: 公司采购最关心能不能报销：先把发票能开什么、不能开什么说清，再算好总价，最后一个问题推进下单。

cases.situation: I sell silver pendant necklaces on Instagram for $68 each, with a gift box, shipping in 2 days. I carve and cast every pendant myself in my studio and have work-in-progress photos of each design, but the chains are bought in ready-made. Someone named Leila DMed: 'are these actually handmade or just resold? lots of shops say handmade lol'.
cases.reply: Hi Leila, fair question! The pendants are mine: I carve and cast every one myself in my studio. The chains I buy in ready-made, so the whole necklace isn't handmade. It's $68 with a gift box, and ships in 2 days. Want me to send you a work-in-progress photo of the design you're looking at?
cases.note: A provenance question gets exactly what you make and what you buy in; an honest 'mostly' beats a claim a customer can disprove.

cases.situation: 我在淘宝开定制窗帘小店，燕麦色遮光帘每米128元，含加工和挂钩，用布一般是窗户宽度的2倍，做好后7天左右发货。布样每份5元包邮，之后下单可以抵扣。有顾客私信：“这款燕麦色多少钱一米？能先寄布样吗？怕有色差。”
cases.reply: 可以先寄布样！燕麦色遮光帘每米128元，含加工和挂钩；用布一般是窗户宽度的2倍，做好后7天左右发货。布样每份5元包邮，之后下单可以抵扣。要我先给您寄一份吗？
cases.note: 顾客怕色差，就先给她看实物的路；“用布是窗宽的2倍”要在第一次报价时说清，免得量完尺寸才发现总价比想的高一倍。

cases.situation: I'm a massage therapist with a small studio in Leeds: a 60-minute massage is £55 and 90 minutes is £75. Gift vouchers can be for any amount or for a set treatment and last 12 months; I can email a PDF voucher the same day, or post a printed card, which takes two to three days. Tom DMed on Instagram today: 'do you do gift vouchers? my wife's birthday is tomorrow'.
cases.reply: Hi Tom! Yes, vouchers can be for any amount or for a set treatment, and they last 12 months. A 60-minute massage is £55 and 90 minutes is £75. With her birthday tomorrow, I'd go for the PDF voucher, which I can email you today; a printed card takes two to three days by post. Which would you like it for?
cases.note: When the question comes with a deadline, answer it, then steer them to the format that actually arrives in time.

cases.situation: 我在小红书接手绘婚礼请柬定制，全定制每套设计费1200元，档期已经排到明年1月中旬；另外有8款现成模板，可以改名字、日期和地点，600元，一周出稿。印刷每张8元另算。有人私信：“11月底办婚礼，现在定全定制还来得及吗？”
cases.reply: 说实话，全定制来不及了，我的档期已经排到明年1月中旬。如果想赶11月底，可以看看我的8款现成模板，改名字、日期和地点，600元，一周出稿，印刷每张8元另算。要我把8款模板发给你挑吗？
cases.note: 档期满了也先答能不能，再给一个赶得上的选项；不硬接，也不让对方空手走。
